nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Cream Intense Hydration Moisturizer

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter flaking, cracked hands, and extremely dry hands, elbows, legs and feet, describe the cream as fast-absorbing and effective at relieving dryness, though one reviewer says none of the current line's products help her dry skin since her favorite variant was discontinued.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several call it their holy grail for eczema, rosacea or acne-prone sensitive skin with no breakouts or irritation, while others report burning, tingling, or breakouts despite marketing aimed at sensitive and eczema-prone skin.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter flaking and itching, report intense, long-lasting hydration without a greasy feel; some note that despite the 'Ultra Repair' name the moisturizing effect feels light, and one reviewer with extremely dry hands felt no effect after a single use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea or eczema, report calmer, less red-looking skin within days of use, with reduced inflammation around blemishes; one reviewer instead experienced burning and tingling that intensified after application, which she attributes to the eucalyptus oil.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cream as strengthening and repairing a stressed skin barrier, including during active rosacea flares, though one recommends against using it on a truly raw or damaged barrier because of the eucalyptus oil; a couple of reviewers instead report the cream itself irritated and dried out their skin.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers say the cream doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts and can calm inflammation around existing blemishes; a couple of reviewers instead report their skin broke out within the first few days of use.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture that absorbs well
Detectable eucalyptus scent despite unscented label
Recent formula and packaging changes disappoint

extraits.texte: I was excited to give the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Cream a try after seeing it hyped up on various social media platforms as being great for sensitive and eczema prone skin. Sadly, this product did not work for me. As soon as the product touched the skin on my hands and face, I immediately felt a tingling and burning sensation that continued to intensify and irritate even after I washed it off. Based on my experience, I am very surprised that this product is labeled as being accepted by the National Eczema Association and is marketed as being suitable for sensitive skin. I suspect that this untoward reaction was likely due to the eucalyptus oil. I would describe the texture and consistency of this cream as being comparable and very similar to Noxzema which I tried as a teenager, and leaves the skin with that same tingling and burning sensation even after being rinsed off.

extraits.titre: Great product! My dry skin's holy grail!
extraits.texte: I picked this up when my skin was flaking from winter + retinol, and wow. This is true intense hydration without feeling greasy or heavy. What I love: • Texture: Thick but sinks in fast. No sticky film, no pilling under makeup. • Relief: Instantly calms that tight, itchy dry feeling. My redness was down by day 3. • Ingredients: Colloidal oatmeal + shea butter combo is perfect for my sensitive skin. Fragrance-free = no irritation. • Lasting power: Actually keeps my skin hydrated for 24 hours. I wake up still soft, not dry. Results after 2 weeks: Skin barrier feels stronger, no more flaky patches around my nose/chin, and makeup sits way better. Even my eczema-prone spots stopped freaking out. Worth noting: A little goes a long way. The tub is huge and lasts months. If your skin is oily, maybe use as a night cream only. But for dry/dehydrated/sensitive skin? 10/10. Would repurchase forever. This replaced 3 other moisturizers in my routine.

extraits.titre: A Lifesaver for Rosacea Flares & Irritation
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've known about First Aid Beauty for a while, so I was excited to receive this jar for free to test out. I have very dry skin and diagnosed rosacea that flares up severely. While testing this, I actually had a bad rosacea flare and hives (unrelated to this product). Even with my skin being that irritated, this cream was incredibly effective, and had no negative impact on my skin during this sensitive time. The consistency is a perfect whipped texture that sinks in quickly. It actually felt really nice and had a slight cooling sensation on my "hot" skin. I'd highly recommend to anyone with rosacea, or dry sensitive skin. I've been using it for several weeks on my face, neck, and hands. The first morning after trying it, my skin was visibly glowing. It's also been wonderful for healing irritated spots; I noticed that after cleansing, applying this dramatically decreased the inflammation and redness of my pimples. I think the combination of the colloidal oatmeal and the eucalyptus is what helps so much with that. One thing to note is the scent. While it's labeled unscented, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil is listed as the last ingredient, and it is immediately noticeable—reminding me of Noxzema. Because of that oil, I wouldn't advise using this on a truly damaged or "raw" skin barrier, as it might sting a little at first. However, on my typical dry/sensitive skin, it has been great.
